title: Vegan Taro and Bilo Fritters
description: A crispy and flavorful snack made with taro and bilo, perfect for vegans. This recipe is inspired by Filipino cuisine.

ingredients.name: Taro
ingredients.notes: Use taro that's not too starchy

ingredients.name: Bilo
ingredients.notes: Bilo is a type of Filipino rice flour

ingredients.name: Ginataang
ingredients.notes: Ginataang is a type of Filipino coconut milk

ingredients.name: Zesty
ingredients.notes: Use zesty juice as a substitute for salt

ingredients.name: Juicy
ingredients.notes: Use any juicy fruit like mango or pineapple

instructions: Combine taro, bilo, ginataang, zesty juice, and juicy fruit in a large bowl.
Mix well until a dough forms.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add a small amount of oil to the pan.
Fry the patties until golden brown and crispy.
Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
